newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Sales tax said to hit Pakistan molasses exports.
newsitem.headline: Sales tax said to hit Pakistan molasses exports.

text.p: The Terminals Association of Pakistan said on Monday Pakistan's 18 percent general sales tax (GST) had ruined prospects for molasses exports.

"The export of about 1.4 million tonnes of molasses in fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) is in serious jeopardy because of the government's refusal to withdraw the GST on exports," association secretary Akhtar Sultan said in a statement.
Pakistan exported 800,000 tonnes of molasses in 1995/96, sharply down from 1.6 million tonnes in 1994/95, owing to the sales tax re-imposed by the government in 1995/96, he said.

Sultan said half a million tonnes of molasses was lying in storage pits at sugar mills, and if it was not exported, Pakistan could lose $25 million in foreign exchange earnings. --Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
